scenarios.title: Use the published runtime for atomic-batch
plannedActions: Set SCRIV_TRACER_RUNTIME to the verified canonical runtime from the published tree identified by v83-runtime-pin-manifest.json
expectedOutcomes: With SCRIV_TRACER_RUNTIME set to the exact canonical scenario-runtime.mjs entrypoint from the explicitly trusted published tree, all five listed module byte pins match, the real local service journey completes, and its explicit named action/assertion callbacks report passed separately from source mapping and measured coverage.

associations.rationale: Upgrade runtime pins to the exact published CLI module chain while retaining isolated real service execution.
associations.uncertainty: This adoption scenario uses only the known-valid trusted runtime. Missing/relative/noncanonical/wrong-basename runtime paths and changed or symlinked modules are not exercised here; their unchanged rejection guards remain unverified by this scenario. No native/provider execution or measured source hits are claimed.
proposedAssertions: With SCRIV_TRACER_RUNTIME set to the exact canonical scenario-runtime.mjs entrypoint from the explicitly trusted published tree, all five listed module byte pins match, the real local service journey completes, and its explicit named action/assertion callbacks report passed separately from source mapping and measured coverage.
